device.label: LED device
device.description: Name under /sys/class/leds. On this Dell Precision 3590 it is dell::kbd_backlight.

default_level.label: Default level
default_level.description: Level a toggle turns the light on to on a first run, before any level has been remembered.

poll_seconds.label: Poll seconds
poll_seconds.description: How often the service re-reads the level from sysfs, so the Fn key stays in step with the widget.

show_level.label: Show the level
show_level.description: Draw level/max next to the glyph on the bar. Turn it off for a glyph-only widget.
